name: Daedelus
hook: A Los Angeles electronic musician whose chord-organ tune became the loop of Madvillain's 'Accordion'.
blurb: Alfred Darlington, who records as Daedelus, came up with a melody in a piano class at the University of Southern California in the late 1990s. In 2002 he recorded it on a Magnus electric chord organ, a cheap home instrument, for a track called 'Experience' on his first album, Invention. Madlib sampled it for Madvillain's 'Accordion' in 2004, which is why the famous 'accordion' sound isn't an accordion: that detail is kept because it corrects an assumption the song's own title spreads. Daedelus is a much-sampled source (Q21) from inside the same Los Angeles beat scene Madlib worked in, so this is a sample between people working at the same time, not the rediscovery of an old record.
